geoexpro_small_fields.claim: Fields under 100 MMboe that started since 2010 tend to shrink after start-up; large fields are more predictable (Wittemann / GEO ExPro, May 2021).
geoexpro_small_fields.our_test: Start-up 2010 or later, first Sodir estimate before start-up (approx. PDO) compared with the latest estimate.

chalk.claim: Chalk fields grow the most in per cent.
chalk.our_test: Fields on stream before 2004: latest estimate / estimate at 31.12.2004, chalk against sandstone. This enters mid-life; growth before 2004 is not in the Sodir table (see the Watkins comparison for that).
